AdvancementRewardDef.description:
One of our own advancements, such as a realm's unlock ``realmforge:realm/<id>``; per player and claimed by
itself. A chapter's advancement comes from ``completes_chapter`` instead.

advancement.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.
advancement.title: Advancement

anyOf.description: Keeps the task's or reward's id stable. Defaults to its type and target (item:minecraft:diamond); set it only to tell two tasks or rewards of one quest apart, or to keep the old id after the target changes.

AdvancementRewardDef.title: AdvancementRewardDef

AdvancementTaskDef.description: Have an advancement, or one of its criteria. Retroactive: an advancement earned before counts.

advancement.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.
advancement.title: Advancement

criterion.description: One criterion of the advancement; empty for the whole advancement.

title.description: Replaces FTB Quests' own title for the task (e.g. 'Kill 10 Zombie').

BuyDef.description:
Makes the quest a purchase in the quest shop (Q1-4, RLM-424; realm portal design, "Realm signets"): its task
takes coins and its reward is an item. The pipeline writes one quest per allowed purchase, each opening with the
one before it, since FTB Quests has no repeat limit of its own; after the last, the shop is closed for good.

limit.description: How often it can be bought, then never again: 3 for a realm's lost signet.
limit.title: Limit

price.description: What a purchase costs, in the smallest coin (copper), the same every time: 50 is 50 Copper Coins, 250 is 2 Silver Coins and 50 Copper Coins. The quest takes the coins.
price.title: Price

BuyDef.title: BuyDef

Complete a run of a dungeon type, or of any dungeon: be in its party when its goal is done
(``realmforge:dungeon_completed``). A run completed before the quest opened counts, as for every advancement.

XpRewardDef.description:
Character XP, with the player's XP multiplier and level-ups (architecture 10.2). Never written in a quest's
``rewards``: the pipeline computes it from the quest's ``level`` and ``type``, or takes the quest's ``xp``
(``quest_xp``, RLM-189). With a ``level`` it is paid by ``/realmforge xp quest``, which lowers it for a player far
above the quest; without one by ``/realmforge xp add``.

anyOf.description: Keeps the task's or reward's id stable. Defaults to its type and target (item:minecraft:diamond); set it only to tell two tasks or rewards of one quest apart, or to keep the old id after the target changes.

XpRewardDef.title: XpRewardDef

description: A quest in the quest book: where it stands, what opens it, what completes it and what it gives.

bring.description: With what: items the player should have with them.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

bring.title: Bring

buy.description: Makes the quest a purchase in the quest shop: it takes coins and gives an item, up to its limit. Such a quest has no tasks, rewards or XP of its own and is optional.

chapter.description: The chapter of content/chapters/ whose page shows the quest.
chapter.title: Chapter

completes_chapter.description: The chapter's last quest: it grants the chapter's advancement realmforge:chapter/<chapter>, per player and claimed by itself, which raises the level cap.
completes_chapter.title: Completes Chapter

craft.description: With what: items the player crafts on the way; each needs a recipe (ours or vanilla).

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

craft.title: Craft

dependencies.description: Quests that must be completed before this one opens.

items.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.

dependencies.title: Dependencies

description.description: The quest's text, one entry per paragraph.
description.title: Description

hide_until_dependencies_complete.description: Show the quest on its chapter's page only once every quest it depends on is completed.
hide_until_dependencies_complete.title: Hide Until Dependencies Complete

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

icon.description: An item shown as the quest's icon; FTB Quests picks one from the tasks without it.
icon.title: Icon

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

level.description: With what: the recommended character level, within the realm's level band and at most the cap its chapter leaves. Required for an errand (any task but a checkmark, a level or a spell).
level.title: Level

optional.description: Optional quests do not count towards the chapter's progress.
optional.title: Optional

place.description: Where, more precisely: the structure or biome in the realm the quest sends to.

realm.description: Where: the realm of content/realms/ the quest takes place in (overworld for the Overworld). Its mandatory quests are its non-optional quests of the same chapter (requires_mandatory).
realm.title: Realm

requires_mandatory.description: The realm's final boss quest (RLM-367): it also waits for every mandatory (non-optional) quest of its realm in its chapter, so killing the boss alone opens nothing.
requires_mandatory.title: Requires Mandatory

rewards.description: Items and advancements. Character XP is computed from the quest's level and type (or its xp).
rewards.title: Rewards

tasks.description: Every task must be done to complete the quest. At least one, unless the quest buys something.
tasks.title: Tasks

type.description: What the quest is, which scales its XP: small (x 0.5), standard (x 1), main (a step of the chapter's main questline, x 1.5), dungeon (x 2) or finale (the chapter's last quest, x 4).
type.title: Type

xp.description: Replaces the character XP the pipeline computes from the quest's level and type, for a special quest; 0 for none. A quest without a level gives XP only through this.
xp.title: Xp
